title: Matterbridge zigbee2mqtt plugin
description: matterbridge-zigbee2mqtt - supports MQTT broker and direct WebSocket to Zigbee2MQTT frontend

transport.title: Transport Mode
transport.description: Select 'mqtt' (requires an MQTT broker) or 'websocket' (connects directly to Zigbee2MQTT frontend API, no MQTT broker needed)

host.title: Host
host.description: Zigbee2MQTT hostname or IP (websocket mode) or MQTT broker host (mqtt mode). In websocket mode, use IP or hostname (e.g. 192.168.1.100). In mqtt mode, use full URL with protocol (e.g. mqtt://host, mqtts://host, ws://host).

port.title: Port
port.description: Zigbee2MQTT frontend port (websocket mode, default: 8080) or MQTT broker port (mqtt mode, default: 1883).

token.title: Auth Token
token.description: Zigbee2MQTT frontend auth_token (only used in websocket mode). Leave empty if no auth_token is configured in Zigbee2MQTT.

mqttHost.title: MQTT Broker URL
mqttHost.description: MQTT broker URL (only used in mqtt mode). E.g. mqtt://host, mqtts://host, ws://host, wss://host, mqtt+unix:///path

mqttPort.title: MQTT Port
mqttPort.description: MQTT broker port (only used in mqtt mode, default: 1883).

mqttUsername.title: MQTT Username
mqttUsername.description: MQTT username for authentication (only used in mqtt mode).

mqttPassword.title: MQTT Password
mqttPassword.description: MQTT password for authentication (only used in mqtt mode).

protocolVersion.title: MQTT Protocol Version
protocolVersion.description: MQTT server protocol version 3, 4 or 5 (default 5). Only used in mqtt mode.

username.title: MQTT Username (legacy)
username.description: MQTT server authentication user (legacy field, prefer mqttUsername). Only required if the MQTT server requires authentication.

password.title: MQTT Password (legacy)
password.description: MQTT server authentication password (legacy field, prefer mqttPassword).

clientId.title: MQTT Client ID
clientId.description: MQTT clientId identifier. If not set, a random clientId will be generated. Only used in mqtt mode.

ca.title: MQTT CA Certificate
ca.description: Absolute path to the SSL/TLS CA certificate (PEM format). Only used in mqtt mode with mqtts://.

rejectUnauthorized.title: MQTT Reject Unauthorized
rejectUnauthorized.description: Reject unauthorized MQTT server. Only used for secure connections (mqtt mode).

cert.title: MQTT Client Certificate
cert.description: Absolute path to the SSL/TLS MQTT client certificate (PEM format). Only used in mqtt mode.

key.title: MQTT Client Private Key
key.description: Absolute path to the SSL/TLS MQTT client private key (PEM format). Only used in mqtt mode.

topic.title: Base Topic
topic.description: MQTT base topic for Zigbee2MQTT messages. This should match the base_topic in your Zigbee2MQTT configuration.yaml.

zigbeeFrontend.title: Zigbee Frontend
zigbeeFrontend.description: Zigbee frontend host to prefix the configUrl from matterbridge frontend (i.e. http://192.168.1.100:8080)

whiteList.title: White List
whiteList.description: Only the devices in the list will be exposed. If the list is empty, all the devices will be exposed.

blackList.title: Black List
blackList.description: The devices in the list will not be exposed. If the list is empty, no devices will be excluded.

switchList.title: Switch List
switchList.description: The devices in the list will be exposed like switches.

lightList.title: Light List
lightList.description: The devices in the list will be exposed like lights.

outletList.title: Outlet List
outletList.description: The devices in the list will be exposed like outlets.

featureBlackList.title: Feature Black List
featureBlackList.description: The features in the list will not be exposed for all devices.

deviceFeatureBlackList.title: Device Feature Black List
deviceFeatureBlackList.description: List of features not to be exposed for a single device.

additionalProperties.description: List of features not to be exposed for this device.

scenesType.title: Scenes Device Type
scenesType.description: Device type to use to expose scenes.

scenesPrefix.title: Scenes Prefix
scenesPrefix.description: Add the device/group friendly name before the scene name.

postfix.title: Device Postfix
postfix.description: Add this unique postfix (3 characters max) to each device serial to avoid collision with other instances.

debug.title: Enable Debug
debug.description: Enable the debug for the plugin (development only)

unregisterOnShutdown.title: Unregister On Shutdown
unregisterOnShutdown.description: Unregister all devices on shutdown (development only)
